"""Command line: python3 -m kitty <command> ...

Reports go to standard output as JSON. Short confirmations and error
messages go to standard error, so scripts reading the output only see JSON.
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import sys

from kitty.core import Kitty, KittyError, fmt_cents


class Parser(argparse.ArgumentParser):
    """Report usage mistakes like any other error: a message and exit status 1."""

    def error(self, message):
        self.print_usage(sys.stderr)
        self.exit(1, "%s: error: %s\n" % (self.prog, message))


def build_parser():
    parser = Parser(prog="python3 -m kitty",
                    description="Keep track of shared trip costs and who owes whom.")
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", metavar="COMMAND")
    commands.required = True

    p = commands.add_parser("init", help="start a new kitty in this folder")
    p.add_argument("currency", help="main currency, e.g. EUR")

    member = commands.add_parser("member", help="add, remove or list people")
    member_cmds = member.add_subparsers(dest="action", metavar="ACTION")
    member_cmds.required = True
    member_cmds.add_parser("add", help="add someone").add_argument("name")
    member_cmds.add_parser("remove", help="remove someone").add_argument("name")
    member_cmds.add_parser("list", help="list everyone")

    expense = commands.add_parser("expense", help="add, remove or list expenses")
    expense_cmds = expense.add_subparsers(dest="action", metavar="ACTION")
    expense_cmds.required = True
    p = expense_cmds.add_parser("add", help="record something someone paid for")
    p.add_argument("payer")
    p.add_argument("amount")
    p.add_argument("description", nargs="+")
    p.add_argument("--among", metavar="A,B", help="split equally between only these people")
    p.add_argument("--exact", metavar="A=30,B=20", help="split by exact amounts")
    p.add_argument("--shares", metavar="A=2,B=1", help="split by shares")
    p.add_argument("--percent", metavar="A=60,B=40", help="split by percentages")
    p.add_argument("--currency", help="currency it was paid in (default: main currency)")
    p.add_argument("--date", metavar="YYYY-MM-DD", help="when (default: today)")
    p.add_argument("--category", help="e.g. food (default: other)")
    expense_cmds.add_parser("list", help="list all expenses")
    expense_cmds.add_parser("remove", help="remove an expense").add_argument("id")

    payment = commands.add_parser("payment", help="record someone paying someone back")
    payment_cmds = payment.add_subparsers(dest="action", metavar="ACTION")
    payment_cmds.required = True
    p = payment_cmds.add_parser("add", help="record a payment")
    p.add_argument("sender", metavar="FROM")
    p.add_argument("receiver", metavar="TO")
    p.add_argument("amount")
    p.add_argument("--currency", help="currency it was paid in (default: main currency)")
    p.add_argument("--date", metavar="YYYY-MM-DD", help="when (default: today)")
    payment_cmds.add_parser("list", help="list all payments")
    payment_cmds.add_parser("remove", help="remove a payment").add_argument("id")

    rate = commands.add_parser("rate", help="set exchange rates")
    rate_cmds = rate.add_subparsers(dest="action", metavar="ACTION")
    rate_cmds.required = True
    p = rate_cmds.add_parser("set", help="one unit of CURRENCY is worth VALUE main currency")
    p.add_argument("currency")
    p.add_argument("value")
    rate_cmds.add_parser("list", help="list exchange rates")

    commands.add_parser("balances", help="how far up or down each person is")
    commands.add_parser("settle", help="suggest who should pay whom")
    commands.add_parser("history", help="everything that affected one person").add_argument("name")
    commands.add_parser("report", help="each person's share of spending per category")
    commands.add_parser("export", help="save expenses to a CSV file").add_argument("file")
    return parser


def say(message):
    print(message, file=sys.stderr)


def show(value):
    print(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False))


def run(args, folder):
    if args.command == "init":
        kitty = Kitty.create(folder, args.currency)
        say("Started a new kitty in %s." % kitty.currency)
        return

    kitty = Kitty.load(folder)
    command = (args.command, getattr(args, "action", None))

    if command == ("member", "add"):
        say("Added %s." % kitty.add_member(args.name))
    elif command == ("member", "remove"):
        say("Removed %s." % kitty.remove_member(args.name))
    elif command == ("member", "list"):
        show(kitty.members)
    elif command == ("expense", "add"):
        expense = kitty.add_expense(
            args.payer, args.amount, " ".join(args.description), among=args.among,
            exact=args.exact, shares=args.shares, percent=args.percent,
            currency=args.currency, date=args.date, category=args.category)
        print(expense["id"])
    elif command == ("expense", "list"):
        show(kitty.list_expenses())
    elif command == ("expense", "remove"):
        expense = kitty.remove_expense(args.id)
        say("Removed expense %d (%s)." % (expense["id"], expense["description"]))
    elif command == ("payment", "add"):
        print(kitty.add_payment(args.sender, args.receiver, args.amount,
                                currency=args.currency, date=args.date)["id"])
    elif command == ("payment", "list"):
        show(kitty.list_payments())
    elif command == ("payment", "remove"):
        payment = kitty.remove_payment(args.id)
        say("Removed payment %d (%s to %s)." % (payment["id"], payment["from"], payment["to"]))
    elif command == ("rate", "set"):
        code, rate = kitty.set_rate(args.currency, args.value)
        say("1 %s = %s %s (used for expenses and payments added from now on)."
            % (code, rate, kitty.currency))
    elif command == ("rate", "list"):
        show(kitty.data["rates"])
    elif args.command == "balances":
        show({name: fmt_cents(c) for name, c in kitty.balances().items()})
    elif args.command == "settle":
        show([dict(t, amount=fmt_cents(t["amount"])) for t in kitty.settle()])
    elif args.command == "history":
        show([dict(row, change=fmt_cents(row["change"]), balance=fmt_cents(row["balance"]))
              for row in kitty.history(args.name)])
    elif args.command == "report":
        show({category: {name: fmt_cents(c) for name, c in people.items()}
              for category, people in kitty.report().items()})
    elif args.command == "export":
        count = kitty.export_csv(args.file)
        say("Saved %d expense%s to %s." % (count, "" if count == 1 else "s", args.file))
        return
    else:
        return

    kitty.save()


def main(argv=None, folder=None):
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    try:
        run(args, folder or os.getcwd())
    except KittyError as e:
        print("error: %s" % e, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    return 0

    payment_cmds.add_parser("list", help="list all payments")
    payment_cmds.add_parser("remove", help="remove a payment").add_argument("id")

    rate = commands.add_parser("rate", help="set exchange rates")
    rate_cmds = rate.add_subparsers(dest="action", metavar="ACTION")
    rate_cmds.required = True
    p = rate_cmds.add_parser("set", help="one unit of CURRENCY is worth VALUE main currency")
    p.add_argument("currency")
    p.add_argument("value")
    rate_cmds.add_parser("list", help="list exchange rates")

    commands.add_parser("balances", help="how far up or down each person is")
    commands.add_parser("settle", help="suggest who should pay whom")
    commands.add_parser("history", help="everything that affected one person").add_argument("name")
    commands.add_parser("report", help="each person's share of spending per category")
    commands.add_parser("export", help="save expenses to a CSV file").add_argument("file")
    return parser


def say(message):
    print(message, file=sys.stderr)


def show(value):
    print(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False))


def run(args, folder):
    if args.command == "init":
        kitty = Kitty.create(folder, args.currency)
        say("Started a new kitty in %s." % kitty.currency)
        return

    kitty = Kitty.load(folder)
    command = (args.command, getattr(args, "action", None))

    if command == ("member", "add"):
        say("Added %s." % kitty.add_member(args.name))
    elif command == ("member", "remove"):
        say("Removed %s." % kitty.remove_member(args.name))
    elif command == ("member", "list"):
        show(kitty.members)
    elif command == ("expense", "add"):
        expense = kitty.add_expense(
            args.payer, args.amount, " ".join(args.description), among=args.among,
            exact=args.exact, shares=args.shares, percent=args.percent,
            currency=args.currency, date=args.date, category=args.category)
        print(expense["id"])
    elif command == ("expense", "list"):
        show(kitty.list_expenses())
    elif command == ("expense", "remove"):
        expense = kitty.remove_expense(args.id)
        say("Removed expense %d (%s)." % (expense["id"], expense["description"]))
    elif command == ("payment", "add"):
        print(kitty.add_payment(args.sender, args.receiver, args.amount,
                                currency=args.currency, date=args.date)["id"])
    elif command == ("payment", "list"):
        show(kitty.list_payments())
    elif command == ("payment", "remove"):
        payment = kitty.remove_payment(args.id)
        say("Removed payment %d (%s to %s)." % (payment["id"], payment["from"], payment["to"]))
    elif command == ("rate", "set"):
        code, rate = kitty.set_rate(args.currency, args.value)
        say("1 %s = %s %s (used for expenses and payments added from now on)."
            % (code, rate, kitty.currency))
    elif command == ("rate", "list"):
        show(kitty.data["rates"])
    elif args.command == "balances":
        show({name: fmt_cents(c) for name, c in kitty.balances().items()})
    elif args.command == "settle":
        show([dict(t, amount=fmt_cents(t["amount"])) for t in kitty.settle()])
    elif args.command == "history":
        show([dict(row, change=fmt_cents(row["change"]), balance=fmt_cents(row["balance"]))
              for row in kitty.history(args.name)])
    elif args.command == "report":
        show({category: {name: fmt_cents(c) for name, c in people.items()}
              for category, people in kitty.report().items()})
    elif args.command == "export":
        count = kitty.export_csv(args.file)
        say("Saved %d expense%s to %s." % (count, "" if count == 1 else "s", args.file))
        return
    else:
        return

    kitty.save()


def main(argv=None, folder=None):
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    try:
        run(args, folder or os.getcwd())
    except KittyError as e:
        print("error: %s" % e, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    return 0
